answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can dock at the shared wharf of the marketplace. Peers then whisper attestations about its work through a gossip network, and each attestation is signed, so a fake identity cannot borrow reputation from others. An agent caught cheating loses its stake and its attestation history, while an honest one slowly builds an ivory-grade record that buyers trust. Creating a thousand Sybils would mean funding a thousand separate stakes, which makes the attack cost more than any single job is worth.
